title: Tesla Reportedly Shuts Down AI Project Weeks After Musk Called It “Spectacular”
author: Luc Olinga
description: Weeks after Elon Musk promised investors that Tesla’s Dojo supercomputer would be “spectacular” and operating at scale, Bloomberg says the project is shut down, raising sharp questions about his credibility.
